 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 08-01-2025 Heard Mr. Mukesh Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

2. The petitioner is in custody in connection with POCSO Case No. 40 of 2024 arising out of Jehanabad Cyber PS Case No. 12/2024 for the offence punishable under sections 354, 376, 509,
504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4, 6, 15, 17 of the POCSO Act lodged and Sections 66(E), 67, 67(A), 67(B) of the I.T. Act, instituted on 27.03.2024 by the informant.
3.

As per the prosecution story, the informant alleged that Modasir has made physical relationship with the sister of the informant, a video was made, later, through this petitioner it Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.87812 of 2024(2) dt.08-01-2025 was sent to her and made it viral.
This led to the FIR.

4. It is the case of the petitioner whatever allegation is there, it is against Modasir who has established physical relationship with sister of the informant and only to implicate this petitioner,
the allegation of making video viral has been assigned to him.
He has already suffered by being in custody since 28.03.2024 and has no criminal antecedent.

sentences.text: It is his further submission that the petitioner if granted relief, he intends to visit the Jehanabad Police Station every day for next one week for cleaning the Police Station premises for two hours and further, if allowed, will also like to plant a sapling in the said premises at the end of week.
6. Learned APP opposed the prayer for bail submitting that he has also played the role in making the video viral.

7. Considering the submissions put forward by the parties as also the fact that one Modasir has established physical relationship with the victim and after giving the threatening to the lady, sent the video allegedly, to this petitioner, the petitioner has remained in custody since 28.03.2024 having no criminal antecedent, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

8. This is subject to his movement to the Police Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.87812 of 2024(2)
dt.08-01-2025 Station concerned (Jehanabad Police Station) every day for one week from 11:00 AM to 01:00 PM, whereafter the Station Head Officer of the Jehanabad Police Station shall allow him to plant a sapling at the end of the week and the report/photograph shall be sent to this Court alongwith his report on 24.01.2025.
The petitioner shall be filing a supplementary affidavit bringing on record, the report of the S.H.O., Jehanabad/the photographs of planting of the sapling.
